- Budget approval window closes on 2026-07-01 (finance needs final numbers by then)

- If possible, we prefer signature by 2026-07-10 to allow for internal routing and PO issuance

I uploaded procurement contacts to the CSV Ben sent — procurement@atlasbio.com is the shared inbox; primary contact for this is Derek Cho (derek.cho@atlasbio.com).

2) Can Redwood provide an estimated token-cost range for the 90-day pilot (for budget approval)?

Happy to jump on a quick 20-min slot with Derek and your team next week if that helps align dates.
